title: NPS primary-reason prompt fragments
summary: This topic is dominated by survey prompt text about the primary reason for an NPS rating, with only one evaluative fragment mentioning early issues that lowered a score.

negative.summary: The only negative fragment says the rating would have been higher without two issues in the first couple of months.

undetermined.summary: Most fragments are non-evaluative survey wording asking for the primary reason for an NPS rating, so they do not reveal a clear opinion about the vehicle.

limitations: The sample is dominated by repeated survey prompt text rather than substantive customer comments.
Only one evaluative example is available, so concrete themes within this topic are insufficiently evidenced.
Because many fragments are undetermined and formulaic, the topic reflects questionnaire wording more than a coherent product issue or benefit.
